environment.description: Same IoT gateway service deployed in a namespace with label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' level). The namespace also carries pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.28. Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, v1.28 GA) rejects any pod spec containing spec.hostPID, spec.hostNetwork, spec.volumes[*].hostPath, or securityContext.privileged=true. The OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sPSPHostNetworkingPorts' is deployed cluster-wide in dryrun mode (note: dryrun only, not enforce). Node-level kernel is configured with kernel.perf_event_paranoid=2 but this is set via a DaemonSet configmap, not a sysctl enforcement. The container runtime is containerd 1.7 with default AppArmor profile 'runtime/default' applied.
